en.io: Input: user request, repository context, AGENTS.md, and Hyperflow memory. Output: optional .hyperflow/specs/<slug>.md, required .hyperflow/tasks/<slug>.md, verification plan, and dispatch handoff.
en.boundary: Planning only: it forbids source-code edits. Design-path questions and approvals may pause execution. The resulting plan reflects repository evidence available at planning time and does not establish implementation feasibility until executed.
dependencies: Hyperflow dispatch skill for automatic handoff
scenarios: Turn an ambiguous idea into a design and plan.
Prepare a task file for later execution.

zh.io: 输入：用户请求、仓库上下文、AGENTS.md 和 Hyperflow 记忆。输出：可选的 .hyperflow/specs/<slug>.md、必需的 .hyperflow/tasks/<slug>.md、验证计划和执行交接。
zh.boundary: 只做规划，禁止修改源代码。设计路径中的问题和审批可能暂停流程。计划基于当时可读的仓库证据，实际可行性需执行后才能确认。
dependencies: 可读的仓库和项目指令
用于自动交接的 Hyperflow dispatch 技能
scenarios: 把模糊想法转成设计与计划。
拆解明确的多文件改动。
为后续执行准备任务文件。
